feedTitle: Shipping forecast for the North Irish Sea

items.title: Shipping forecast updated as of 12 October 2026 10:20pm
items.description:
##Current shipping forecast##

Valid for 24 HoursIssued on Monday, 12 October 2026 at 10:20pm by Ronaldsway Met Office
##Warning##

Strong to gale force winds.


##Synopsis##

Low pressure in the Atlantic will drive frontal troughs across the area tonight.


##Wind##

South or Southwest 6 or 7 tonight, possibly touching gale 8 in central areas, although a force or two lighter in Liverpool Bay and Morecambe Bay. Veering West or Southwest 5 or 6 by the end of the night in all waters, occasionally 7 in a few places. Little change during tomorrow morning and afternoon, West 5 or 6 in evening.


##State of Sea##

Moderate, building moderate or rough overnight, then mainly moderate later tomorrow.


##Weather##

Mist patches and occasional rain overnight, clearing to isolated showers before dawn.


##Visibility##

Moderate or poor at times overnight, good tomorrow.


##Outlook for the following 24 hours##


##Wind##

Soon decreasing West or Southwest 4 or 5 tomorrow night, then backing South or Southwest 5 or 6 later. Increasing South or Southwest 6 to gale 8 on Wednesday morning.


##State of Sea##

Moderate, building moderate or rough.


##Weather##

Fair.


##Visibility##

Good.
